name: Clear Woods
description: Cut down the woods on a tile: +25 production toward what this city builds next (more in later eras).

name: Clear Rainforest
description: Clear a rainforest tile: +15 food and +15 production (more in later eras).

name: Drain Marsh
description: Drain a marsh tile: +20 food (more in later eras).

name: Research Grants
description: Fund the scholars of this Campus: half of what it costs comes back as science, plus great scientist points. It can be repeated, and grows with the era.

name: Pilgrimage
description: Pilgrims crowd this Holy Site: three fifths of what it costs comes back as faith, plus great prophet points while a religion can still be founded. Repeatable.

name: Arts Festival
description: A season of plays and poetry at this Theater Square: half of what it costs comes back as culture, plus great writer points. Repeatable.

name: Market Fair
description: Merchants from far and wide come to this Commercial Hub: three quarters of what it costs comes back as gold, plus great merchant points. Repeatable.

name: Trade Fleet
description: Outfit merchant ships at this Harbor: half of what it costs comes back as gold and a fifth as food for the city, plus great admiral points. Repeatable.

name: Engineering Works
description: Train engineers in this Industrial Zone: two fifths of what it costs comes back as gold, plus generous great engineer points. Repeatable.

name: War Games
description: Drill the garrison at this Encampment: a third of what it costs comes back as gold, plus generous great general points. Repeatable.

name: Festival of Games
description: Races and games at this Entertainment Complex: half of what it costs goes toward your next celebration as happiness. Repeatable.

name: Envoys Abroad
description: Send couriers from the Government Plaza: two fifths of what it costs comes back as influence. Repeatable.

name: Launch a Satellite
description: The first step of a science victory (on a Spaceport): +150 science.

name: Moon Landing
description: The second step of a science victory: +300 culture.

name: Mars Colony
description: The third step of a science victory: +400 science.

name: Exoplanet Expedition
description: The last step: a ship to another star. When it arrives, its builder wins.

name: Orbital Laser Relay
description: Pushes your exoplanet expedition faster: it arrives 2 turns sooner. Build it again while the ship is on its way.
